001: Have you gotten used to the new workplace yet?
Yes, I'm getting used to it, little by little.
That's good to hear. Is there anything you're having trouble with?
Well, I'm still not used to the overtime culture.
That's true, this company does have a lot of overtime.
But the people around me are kind, so that helps a lot.
002: What do you think about our company's meetings?
Well, I sometimes feel they're a bit long.
So you feel that way too. I've been wanting to improve that.
I think they'd be shorter if the materials were distributed beforehand.
That's a good suggestion. Let's try it starting next week.
Thank you. I'll help out too.
003: I heard that reporting, informing, and consulting are important in Japanese workplaces.
Yes, they really are. Especially, it's basic to report even small things.
I see. So I should report right away if anything comes up.
Yes, it would help if you did that.
Got it. I'll be careful from now on.
Thank you. If anything comes up, feel free to talk to me anytime.
004: How does everyone usually spend their lunch break?
Well, a lot of people eat together in the cafeteria.
They've invited me too, so I've been eating with them.
That's great. It's a good opportunity to build closer relationships.
Yeah, I get to hear all kinds of stories, and it's a good learning experience.
Please keep joining in from now on.
005: What do you think about this company's evaluation system?
Well, I think the management-by-objectives system is a good framework.
I think so too. The goals are clear, so it's easy to work hard.
However, it would be nice to have a bit more feedback on the evaluations.
True, I feel like there aren't enough review meetings.
Should we suggest that to the higher-ups?
006: Do you often go to the company drinking parties?
Well, I try to attend as much as I can.
I'd like to join too, but I'm not good with alcohol.
That's fine. There are plenty of people who don't drink.
Oh, really? Then I can join without worrying.
Yeah, don't push yourself, just enjoy it at your own pace.
007: Is there anything that bothers you about how the work is done?
Well, I think there could be a little more autonomy.
There are a lot of detailed instructions, so I feel there's not much room to think for myself.
I see. There might be a tendency for that, indeed.
I'll talk to the higher-ups to see if we can improve it.
008: I heard a new project is starting.
Yes, it starts next month. I was chosen to be on the team.
Thank you. But I'm also a bit anxious.
It's an area where I don't have much experience, so I'm worried about causing trouble for everyone.
009: What do you think is the best thing about this company?
Well, I think it's that the communication is open and it's easy to share your opinions.
I feel that way too. Even the opinions of young employees are heard.
I want to keep speaking up actively from now on.
Please do. We're looking forward to it.
010: Are you managing to balance work and your personal life well?
Well, it's going better than before.
Is there anything you're doing differently?
I make a conscious effort to finish my work by the end of my shift.
That's a good idea. I want to follow your example.
Let's both do our best without overdoing it.
